title: The venous thromboembolic complications of shoulder and elbow surgery
design_evidence: We attempted to identify all papers describing cases of deep-vein thrombosis (DVT) and/or pulmonary embolus (PE) after shoulder and elbow surgery published in English before 31 March 2012. We performed an electronic search of Medline using the PubMed search and the EMBASE bibliographical and CINAHL databases.
population: Papers describing VTE after shoulder and elbow surgery; included: 14 papers (8 on shoulder arthroscopy, 6 on shoulder replacement, 3 on proximal humerus fractures, 2 on elbow surgery)
